title: Shinonome Ena — I Want To Make Something Good〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Card: I Want To Make Something Good（3★）
meta.Event: And Now, I Wear This Ribbon

rows.Line: About one year ago
Ena's Room

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What should I draw today...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, right... I uploaded a selfie earlier, huh?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Okay, geez.
You get to be on silent for a while.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I guess I can pick up where I left off and keep working on that drawing from before.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
It became such a mess too...
I should rethink its layout and...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No. I've tried so many different layouts, but none of them seem right...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: When did I become such a bad artist...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
No, I'm not...!
I can...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I can...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I know. I can try watching Amia's video again! That might help me remember what was going through my mind when I was on a roll...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I watched it a few times yesterday and its view count's still going up.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, it's gotten more views! And more comments...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Look, they're all saying how amazing this video is...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: All these people are seeing my art...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I wonder if K's seen this video...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No, who am I kidding...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hm? I thought I disabled notifications for likes...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
No, it's a DM...
Is it from Amia...?

rows.Speaker: Message
rows.Line: <To Enanan...>

rows.Speaker: Message
rows.Line: <My name is K. It's nice to make your acquaintance. I took the liberty of watching the video Amia posted the other day.>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <I was hoping to speak with the artist who drew the illustrations for that video. Is this the correct account?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
No way. Is this really them?!
They're messaging me directly?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
W-Wait, hold on a sec...!
Calm down. Take a deep breath...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: First, I need to see if this is actually them! I mean, what if this is just some imposter?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Still, unlike my selfie account, my main one has hardly any followers. I can't imagine why anyone would try to scam me...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: F-For now, I'll send a quick reply...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (They asked if this is my real account. Does this mean they also saw my selfie account...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Oh geez... What if they think I'm really conceited or something for having an account just for selfies...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh...? They replied back already?!

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <I'm glad I contacted the correct account. I was worried that I'd send a message to the wrong one since so many similar ones exist.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh...
I guess they didn't see it then...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Still, I got a DM from K...
What's this about? Do they want to tell me what they thought of that video?

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <I'd like to get straight to why I decided to contact you. Would it be possible for you to draw the illustrations for the music video for our next song?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No way...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
K... The real K...
Is asking me to draw illustrations?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, that's what they said. There's no doubt about it...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Th-This isn't a dream, right...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
K... K saw...
K saw my art...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Haha...
Geez, my eyes have been like faucets lately...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But I'm so happy... I can't contain myself...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, it's K again.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, they already contacted Amia...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I guess that makes sense considering how amazing that video was. If I'm gonna have my illustrations used in a video, I want Amia to do that.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Also, let's see... Oh, they want to talk on Nightcord...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I get to talk to K?! And Amia?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Of course! I'd absolutely love to!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Thank you for your generous offer, K. I'd be more than happy to draw illustrations for you.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm not really sure what Nightcord is, but I guess I should download it and get it set up.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Actually, I'm gonna do that right now!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe. I get to talk to K... And Amia.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(I wonder what they're like.
I can't wait to talk to them.)
